title: SecOps-NG Control Attestation State
description: Shared four-state vocabulary describing the most recent attestation of a SecOps-NG control. Promoted out of kri.control_effectiveness@v1 (where it was declared in prose only) so that the risk-analysis evidence-artifact schema, the control-effectiveness KRI, and any future effectiveness-loop stream import the same enum without re-declaring it. States are mutually exclusive: a control is in exactly one state at any evaluation timestamp.

x_state_definitions.effective: Latest attestation places the control fully in scope and operating as designed; within the control's declared review_cadence.
x_state_definitions.partially_effective: Latest attestation acknowledges material gaps in coverage or operation, but the control is still partially mitigating the underlying risk; within review_cadence.
x_state_definitions.ineffective: Latest attestation finds the control not operating, or operating in a way that does not mitigate the underlying risk; within review_cadence.
x_state_definitions.overdue: No current attestation within the control's declared review_cadence. Treated as not-effective for residual-exposure calculations.
